implementation_status: Specification artifact; no implemented CLI parser or PDE run

similarity_coordinates.q: unique positive admissible root of q-z^2*q^(2*h)=tau

smooth_step.S: S(s)=0 for s<=0; rho(s)/(rho(s)+rho(1-s)) for 0<s<1; 1 for s>=1

reference_fields.p_S: p_S_raw minus its periodic spatial mean at the same time

mathematical_problem.force_dependence: Prescribed by the fields above; never depends on integrated velocity or numerical grid
mathematical_problem.terminal_extension: Unspecified: no smooth force extension through T_star is claimed

problem_identity.canonicalization: mathematical_problem only; json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True), ASCII bytes, no final newline
problem_identity.scope: Syntactic identity of this exact definition, not mathematical equivalence detection or a source-admissibility certificate
problem_identity.exact_input_policy: All mathematical scalar input values are integer/rational strings, never binary64 literals

diagnostics.identity_scope: Separate from mathematical_problem; changes require a new comparison-protocol identity
diagnostics.interior_mask: Intersect each nominal region with mathematical c_x=1
diagnostics.coverage_measure: Physical volume at each actual comparison time

coverage_quadrature.accuracy_requirement: Independent refinement or enclosure of this quadrature

experiment_proposal.start: Each refinement lineage originates from the exact initial rest state
experiment_proposal.successive_windows: Extend the same immutable input; compare against independently evolved from-rest refinement trajectories

grid_screen.meaning: Cells across the equatorial swirl-peak radius, not diameter
grid_screen.classification: Heuristic resource screen; not an acceptance or convergence criterion
grid_screen.caveat: Coarser comparison grids can shorten the qualified frontier; memory preflight remains mandatory

experiment_proposal.acceptance_contract: COMPLETE_DESIGN.md Sections 6 and 7; no accepted window exists

historical_case.compatibility: Different mathematical problem; cannot resume a v1 checkpoint as v2
